summary: Fix Actions: update tests no longer reach the public apt repository, the local-core TLS address check reads the OpenSSL verdict, the stale API reference is regenerated, a test umask leak is restored, and the ISO source record cites tracked evidence.

guide.reason: Test fixtures, generated reference, and contributor records only; no operator behavior changed.

api.reason: No contract change; docs/api/index.html regenerated from the already-committed openapi.json.

verification.method: go test -race ./...; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --base <parent> --head <commit> in a clean worktree. Affected unit tests also run inside docker.gitea.com/runner-images:ubuntu-latest (OpenSSL 3.0.13).
